messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: display mean in a plot
parts:
Hi Christian,

Because ggplot is made up of independent building blocks, intensively
search the web isn't likely to help you out that much (unless someone
has encountered exactly the same problem as you). What you need to do
is figure out which building blocks you need to combine in order to
solve your problem. You probably want geom_text and stat_summary, but
it's hard to know exactly without a reproducible example of your
existing plot.

Hadley
